Your game. Your style. Your next great shot.

🕹️ TAKE THE TABLE

🛍️ COSMETIC SHOP • IN PREPARATION
Express your style with planned cue designs, table styles and pocket effects:
✨ Stardust pocket effect
🔥 Neon Ember cue
🖤 Obsidian table felt

💎 PPL HOLDER COSMETICS

⚖️ SAME GAME. YOUR OWN STYLE.
All cues share identical physics, power and aim assistance. No account, wallet or token is required to play. Gameplay does not earn PPL or cash rewards.

🪙 TOKEN DETAILS
